title: v1.5.0 — Life Goals Minor & Incremental Progress Tracking
changelog: Life Goals Minor & Incremental Progress: Log granular item increments (pages, minutes, modules, lessons) directly from tracked item cards
1-Tap Quick Increments: Context-aware preset chips (+5, +10, +25 pages; +5m, +10m, +15m; +1, +2) for immediate progress updates
Dedicated Item Progress Modal: Log custom unit deltas or absolute values with reflection notes and custom dates
Deterministic Parent Roll-up: Automatically marks items completed and advances parent goal metrics when 100% target is reached
Audit History & 1-Click Undo: Track recent item progress in the Tracker tab with instant undo and rollback support
Items Tracking Mode: Direct support for item-based goal completion tracking with real-time recalculation
